authoredFrom: Input (built in tests/storage/producer-loss.test.ts from handoff-full.json, seed et005b-handoff-full): simulation.started at 10 ms (eventSeq 1); a job without cargo.loaded or market at 20 ms (2); a toll of 5 at 30 ms (3); the SDK-thread handoff ring full from 40 ms; tolls at 50 and 60 ms (4, 5); the ring drained at 70 ms; a toll at 80 ms (6); job.delivered at 90 ms (7); the clear at 100 ms (8). No frame step, so no snapshot and a checkpoint without a job. One durable connection from 0 to 200 ms that commits and acknowledges each item, recorded through the production wiring (recording-runtime.ts) into synthetic:<name>.

Producer (protocol v1 §9: an event lost because the bounded handoff is full counts as queueCount; D5: a lost event still takes an eventSeq; docs/native-transport-v1.md, callback capture: a full ring keeps the loss run open, and the next copied record carries it as loss_before; handoff-full.expected.json): the tolls 4 and 5 are one loss run, written as the gap [4, 5] (queueCount 2, first lost 1,000,050,000,000 ns, last lost 1,000,060,000,000 ns) right before event 6. ACKs after each commit: 1, 2, 3, 5 (the gap), 6, 7 and 8.

docs/trips.md, load state (T12): the job (2) is configured while running, so trip@2 opens `unknown` with no cause interval, no truck or trailer reference and the unknown game mode; the toll (3) is attributed `trip` (T14).

docs/trips.md, 'any open | gap with a new suffix' (T10) and trip-reducer case 8: the gap [4, 5] closes trip@2 {none, gap, partial} at the session's last label, the toll 3 (1,800,000,000,030, T15), with one event-loss interval (queueCount; trip-reducer T10 table) of its suffix [4, 5], the run's lost times as monotonic bounds on the capture clock and detail {cause: gap, the six counters, the record's range, redelivered: false}. The job becomes untracked.

docs/trips.md, Attribution (T14): the toll 6 while the job is untracked is `ambiguous`; job.delivered (7) is the outcome of an untracked job, `ambiguous`, and closes no trip. The clear (8) adds nothing. Without the loss the trip would have closed complete at the delivery (T13).

Journal (docs/journal.md and docs/storage.md, Window rule J7): the list row is outcome none, close reason gap, partial; its timeline window runs from the job configuration (2) through 3, just before the first eventSeq the gap newly covered (`close-gap`), and its intervals page holds the event-loss interval.

Counts: 7 first commits (6 events, 1 gap); coverage 8. Losses (G6): lostEvents 2 (the gap's newly covered range), eventLoss 1. The recording status carries those losses and the idle trip summary; it reads `waiting` throughout, because no frame publishes a state with an available simulation (docs/telemetry-service-v1.md, Freshness; G3 rule 8).
